integrity.computational_scope: Direct finite exhaustive verification over F2 for n=1,2,3,4.
integrity.known_input: Isomorphism classification and Burnside formula were established previously.
integrity.novelty_caution: Provisional against inspected literature; a broader theorem could subsume the sharp asymptotics.
integrity.proof_claim: All n>=2 exact transposition count and n tending to infinity asymptotics; explicit uniform error proof given.

limitations: Sampling is uniform on invertible labeled structure matrices over the two-element field, not on isomorphism classes.
The infinite asymptotic theorem is proved algebraically; independent enumeration only checks dimensions at most four.
No higher-order expansion or extension to coefficient fields larger than two is claimed.
Independent priority assessment and mathematical validation have not been performed.
title: Sharp rare-symmetry law for perfect binary evolution algebras
